name: GET answered at once with JSON: the request goes out and the answer lands in the same settle — Response, Status Code, Response Headers, done
because: httpnode.ts :494-500 (one request at the frame's end), :1152-1155 (Auto parses application/json), :995-1040, :1160-1162. NSP-007 AC3: the request is in the trace

name: an answer 100 ms away: the request in one settle, nothing at 99, the answer at 100 (the absence beside the firing arm)
because: world.ts NETWORK `after`; NSP-007 AC2's shape for a request

name: a 404 takes the Failure path with http/error-status, Error = 'HTTP 404: Not Found', and the body still lands on Response
because: httpnode.ts :1163-1170. NSP-007 AC3: a failing response takes the Failure path with the contract's `failed`

name: a request that never reaches a server: Failure http/network-error, Error = the error's message, no output moves
no answer and Timeout 1000: at 999 nothing, at 1000 the timeout aborts it — Failure http/timeout, Error names the timeout, no Canceled
because: httnode.ts :1075-1078, :1194-1203 (NDA-012: a timeout is not a cancel)

name: Cancel in flight: done at once; next settle Canceled and the Fetch's unchanged. Cancel with nothing in flight: unchanged
no URL: Failure http/no-url with Error 'URL is required', and no request goes out
POST with two JSON body fields, a header and a query parameter, and a {id} path parameter: the request as it travels
because: httpnode.ts :852-903 buildUrl, :905-927 buildHeaders, :929-968 buildBody json, :1087-1089 the Content-Type it adds

name: URL-encoded and form bodies: the encoding travels; a null field is omitted by both
a 304 pulses Not Modified and settles unchanged; Response keeps the previous body
Response Type JSON on a body that is not JSON: Failure, Error says so — under http/network-error (D11)
because: httpnode.ts :1139-1150 throws into the .catch at :1191-1203, whose code is the network error's

name: two Fetch pulses in one frame: ONE request, two dones
because: httpnode.ts :494-500 scheduleFetch's same-pass guard coalesces the work, never the outcomes (:480-490)

name: two Cancels in one frame: the first aborts and reports done, the second finds the controller already gone and reports unchanged
an earlier request's completion disarms Cancel for a later one (D12): the aborted first request's landing clears the controller of the second, which then cannot be cancelled and completes
because: httpnode.ts :1073-1074 one controller per node, :1176 `abortController = null` in the catch of ANY request

name: the same disarming by a 304 (D12): the first request's Not Modified lands while the second is in flight; Cancel then reports unchanged and the second completes
because: httpnode.ts :1108 `abortController = null` in the then of ANY request, before the 304 branch

name: Bearer authentication adds no header (C7): the presets read a key the ports never write
because: httpnode.ts :131-133 read inputs.authToken; :447-458 store under auth-authToken. The request carries no Authorization — the spec models the runtime until the row is ruled

name: a non-string URL loses the Fetch's outcome for good (C8): nothing is reported, nothing goes out, and the node still works afterwards
because: httpnode.ts :1050-1051 drain the tokens, :1069 `.match` throws, nodecontext.ts :472 swallows it
